MIND. [1] [Arm.]
Difficult thinking in evening.
Melancholy is changed into merry mood.
Anxiety. θ Hydrothorax.
Driven to despair. θ Cramp in stomach.
Worse from nervous excitement ; from vexation.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Arm.]
Syncope.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Arm.]
Violent headache, with vomiting.
Acute pain in head.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arm.]
Rheumatic ophthalmia.
Traumatic inflammation of eyes ; blearedness and cataract.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arm.]
Inflammation of nose. θ With eye complaints.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Arm.]
Toothache, especially of a rheumatic character.
Scorbutis.
Toothache in carious teeth. θ Scurvy.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Arm.]
Glossoplegia.
Tongue furred whitish. θ Cramp in stomach.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arm.]
Clotted blood filled up the open mouth. θ Apparent death.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arm.]
Dryness of pharynx, larynx and posterior nares.
Warm water put in mouth seemed to go no further than throat. θ Apparent death.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Arm.]
From region of stomach pain draws through both sides towards back. θ Cramp in stomach.
Violent cramp in stomach beginning towards morning, continually increasing, driving to despair ; goes from region of stomach through both sides around to back.
Cramp in stomach after taking cold.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Arm.]
Spasmodic affection in abdomen.
Tearing pain from belly through to back, down back and settling in sacrum.
Loins ache.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Arm.]
Mucous stools.
Intestinal catarrh.
Itching and burning at anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Arm.]
Increased secretion of urine.
Nephritis albuminosa, with great paleness, and atony of kidneys.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Arm.]
Impotence, torpidity.
Inflammatory stage of gonorrhœa.
Gonorrhœa, with violent smarting and burning, difficult micturition, and a rather scanty discharge from urethra.
Gonorrhœa, after cutting and burning pains during micturition had been nearly removed by 1st or 2d dilution, the 6th acted with good effect.
Chronic and neglected gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arm.]
Leucorrhœa and menostasis.
Since climaxis, cramp in stomach.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Arm.]
After vexation of mother nursing child vomits milk.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arm.]
Loss of voice ; whispering.
Aphonia, with blood-spitting.
Hoarseness and roughness in throat.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Arm.]
Pituitous asthma.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arm.]
Pituitous consumption.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Arm.]
During convalescence from pneumonia.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Arm.]
No pulsation of heart ; apparent death.
Pulse small. θ Cramp in stomach.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Arm.]
A slight pressure on last dorsal vertebra increases pain exceedingly. θ Cramp in stomach.
Pain from abdomen through to back and down into sacrum.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Arm.]
Suppressed foot sweats.
   

NERVES. [36] [Arm.]
Apparent apoplectic death after a hemorrhage from lungs and nose, with a child suffering from whooping cough.
Asphyxia.
   

TIME. [38] [Arm.]
Morning : borborygmi ; pains in joints ; cramp in stomach worse.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Arm.]
After a cold : cramp in stomach.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Arm.]
Rheumatism, wandering, chronic.
Antiscorbutic.
Dropsy, with albuminuria.
After pneumonia, during reconvalescence.
Beginning enteritis.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arm.]
A woman suffering from violent headache, with vomiting, since climaxis. θ Cramp in stomach.
